title: Modbus TCP active identification (no write/control)
description: Identify Modbus/Modicon devices & unit IDs; read/identify only, no writes.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. Modbus TCP/502 often lacks auth. **Active + read/identify allowed; NO WRITE/CONTROL.** 1) nmap modbus-discover / modbus-discover --script-args to read device ID/unit IDs (confirm read-only). 2) Where a safe read-only client/library is used in-scope, you may read holding/input registers for identification ONLY — never write coils/registers (FC5/6/15/16/22/23 writes forbidden). 3) Schneider Modicon may expose UMAS (Modbus function 0x5A) on 502 — identify/enumerate info read-only; no write/program operations. 4) Record device/unit/vendor as facts with safety note.
